Build-Depends: debhelper-compat (= 13), dh-sequence-python3, pybuild-plugin-pyproject, python3, python3-absl <!nocheck>, python3-cffsubr <!nocheck>, python3-fonttools <!nocheck>, python3-lxml <!nocheck>, python3-picosvg (>= 0.22.1) <!nocheck>, python3-pil <!nocheck>, python3-regex <!nocheck>, python3-setuptools, python3-setuptools-scm, python3-tomli-w <!nocheck>, python3-ufo2ft <!nocheck>, python3-ufolib2 <!nocheck>, python3-zopfli <!nocheck>, ninja-build <!nocheck>, pngquant <!nocheck>, python3-pytest <!nocheck>, resvg <!nocheck>
Description: compiler for color fonts nanoemoji takes a directory of SVG files, one per emoji or other color glyph, and compiles them into a color font. It supports the COLR/CPAL, SVG, CBDT and sbix color font formats, either individually or several of them at once in a single font file, and can also build color variable fonts. . It relies on picosvg to normalize the input SVG files, on ninja to run the individual build steps in parallel, and optionally on resvg and pngquant to rasterize and optimize the bitmap tables.
